llm.summary: This is a transparent Markdown workflow for organizing launch feedback and saving summaries only with user control.

dimensions.detail: The skill consistently focuses on clustering launch comments, reviews, board posts, and support tickets into themes, status-loop rules, shipped-change copy, and compliant social-proof collection guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifact includes clear scope limits: it does not make roadmap decisions, execute outreach, amplify testimonials, compute launch scores, or directly write canonical launch-registry records.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains only SKILL.md, with no executable scripts, install hooks, obfuscation, or runtime code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It may process customer feedback, support tickets, store reviews, and social comments, which can include sensitive customer or business information, but that access is disclosed and directly tied to the purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill can write summaries and candidate records to memory paths, but it instructs the agent to ask before saving results and avoids direct durable decision or registry writes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, consider that the skill is meant to handle launch feedback that may include private customer data. Use only data you are allowed to process, redact sensitive details when practical, and confirm intentionally before saving outputs to memory.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review found no hidden or contradictory behavior.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the single non-executable Markdown artifact.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean across supplied engines and does not conflict with the artifact evidence.
